title: Stripe Nears $7 Billion Deal to Acquire OpenRouter
summary: The prospective takeover would combine AI model routing, usage metering and payments in one powerful infrastructure provider.
body:
Stripe is reportedly nearing an agreement to acquire OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, a transaction that would push the payments company decisively into the infrastructure governing how businesses access and pay for artificial intelligence. Neither company had publicly confirmed a completed deal when the report appeared.

## From negotiations to an advanced deal

The latest report represents a material advance from July, when Stripe was described as one of several potential buyers discussing a purchase valued near $10 billion. The lower figure may reflect a negotiated price or deal structure, but the financial terms remain unconfirmed. Until the companies announce an agreement, completion and final valuation are not assured.

OpenRouter provides one interface for accessing models from competing laboratories and hosting providers. Its routing layer can select providers, manage fallbacks and apply spending or privacy controls without requiring developers to rebuild an application around each model vendor. The company said in May that its weekly traffic had risen from 5 trillion to 25 trillion tokens over six months. It also raised $113 million at a reported $1.3 billion valuation, making even a $7 billion sale a substantial premium.

Stripe already supplies payment services to OpenRouter and has been expanding beyond conventional transaction processing. Its acquisition of usage-billing specialist Metronome and its tools for token-based charging fit naturally with OpenRouter’s metering and routing capabilities. Combining them could give Stripe an integrated system spanning model selection, consumption accounting, developer access and customer billing.

## Why it matters

The proposed price suggests that the neutral layer between model developers and users may become as strategically valuable as individual AI applications. A combined company could simplify purchasing and operating multiple models, particularly for agents that dynamically trade quality, latency and cost. It would also concentrate sensitive information about model demand, pricing and application workloads inside one provider. Customers and model companies will therefore watch whether OpenRouter preserves broad access, transparent routing and commercial neutrality under Stripe’s ownership.
summary_zh: 这笔潜在交易将把模型路由、用量计费与支付整合到同一家基础设施服务商手中，重塑企业采购和调用AI模型的方式。
body_zh:
据报道，Stripe已接近达成协议，将以超过70亿美元收购OpenRouter。这笔交易将推动Stripe从支付服务商进一步转向AI基础设施，切入企业如何选择、调用并支付人工智能模型的关键环节。消息发布时，双方尚未公开确认交易已经签署或完成。

## 收购谈判进入更实质阶段

此次进展不同于7月披露的初步接洽。当时，Stripe只是OpenRouter的多家潜在买家之一，讨论中的估值接近100亿美元。最新报道给出的价格有所下降，可能源于双方重新议价或调整交易结构，但具体条款仍未得到确认。在正式公告发布前，成交与最终估值都存在变数。

OpenRouter通过统一接口连接不同实验室和云服务商提供的模型。其路由系统可以选择供应商、设置故障切换，并执行成本及隐私控制，让开发者不必为每家模型厂商重新改造应用。OpenRouter今年5月表示，平台每周处理的令牌量在半年内由5万亿增至25万亿。公司同期完成1.13亿美元融资，据报道估值为13亿美元；即使最终售价为70亿美元，溢价依然十分可观。

Stripe目前已经为OpenRouter提供支付服务，同时持续把业务拓展到传统交易处理之外。此前收购按用量计费公司Metronome，以及围绕令牌消耗推出收费工具，都与OpenRouter的模型路由和用量统计能力相衔接。两家公司合并后，Stripe可能形成覆盖模型选择、消耗核算、开发者接入和终端客户收费的一体化体系。

## 为何重要

这一潜在成交价说明，连接模型开发商与用户的中间层，战略价值可能不亚于具体AI应用。合并后的平台可以降低企业同时使用多种模型的复杂度，尤其适合需要根据质量、延迟和成本动态选模的智能体。不过，交易也会让一家服务商掌握更多有关模型需求、价格和应用负载的敏感信息。OpenRouter能否继续保持广泛接入、路由透明和商业中立，将成为客户与模型厂商关注的核心问题。
